title: 5.2.8 Lab: Tune Gravity
description: Try different world.gravity.y values on the same scene and describe how each one feels. Change the value, then write one sentence per value as a comment.

steps.title: Try several gravity values
steps.instructions: Change world.gravity.y to 10, then 0, then -5, then 20. Run the sketch after each change and notice how the player moves.
hints: Search the moSHion docs drawer for world.gravity.

steps.title: Note what you noticed
steps.instructions: For each value, write one sentence as a `//` comment at the bottom of the code: did the player fall, float, or drift upward? Fast or slow?

requirements.title: Gravity changed from the starting value
requirements.description: Try a gravity value other than 10 in `world.gravity.y`. Help: 5.2.6 (Reading: Gravity)
